Composition rights
Original composition is public domain in ordinary life-plus-70 jurisdictions. Inferred, not documented

The source notes give C. P. E. Bach’s lifespan as 1714–⁠1788. This does not remove rights in Joan Benson’s recording.

[4] [7]
Recording rights
Rule 1 — recording licence/release: CC BY-SA 2.0 (EFF Open Audio License). Documented

Commons explicitly applies cc-by-sa-2.0 and describes the EFF Open Audio License grant for the Joan Benson recording sourced through Pandora Music. No pre-1963 date is claimed; the 1973 recommendation is not a session date.
